title: Replicate only policy-eligible swarm memory
goal: Synchronize scoped records with provenance, conflict handling, and deletion semantics over authenticated peers; disconnected replicas converge without exporting local-only memory or reviving tombstoned records. Deps (vectors): VC-201-033, VC-201-073, VC-201-081, VC-201-083. Acceptance is tests named vc_201_084_* in the owning crate; write them with the feature.
